errors.text_span: Das linke Diagramm stellt die Diskrepanz zwischen dem IWF-Fiskalindex und der Schuldenquote des Gesamtstaates von 1995 bis ca. 2021 dar.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states 'Diskrepanz' (discrepancy) instead of 'Zusammenhang' (relationship/correlation). The figure shows a relationship, not a discrepancy.
The x-axis range ends at 2020, not 2021.
The description does not state the overall purpose of the figure (to show the relationship between the IWF-Fiskalindex and Schuldenquote for 1995-2020).
The description omits the right y-axis meaning (Schuldenquote) and the left y-axis meaning (IWF-Fiskalindex) for the left diagram.
The description omits the right y-axis meaning (Schuldenquote Zentralstaat) for the right diagram.
The description does not mention the right diagram at all, which is a critical omission.
The description omits the scale ranges for the left diagram (IWF-Fiskalindex: 0-2.5, Schuldenquote: 60-120).
The description omits the scale ranges for the right diagram (IWF-Fiskalindex: -5-2, Schuldenquote: 30-70).
The description does not mention the color distinction of lines and symbols.
The description omits the starting, peak, and end values of the blue and red lines in the left diagram.
The description omits the trend of the blue and red lines in the right diagram.

errors.text_span: Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Jahre auf einer linearen Skala im Bereich von 1995 bis ca. 2021, wobei numer
errors.evidence: The description is cut off and does not specify what the 'numer' refers to (likely 'numerische Werte' or similar, but it is unclear).
